hooks.command: staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only); if [ -z "$staged" ] || [ "$staged" = "src/catalog/data.go" ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git commit is restricted to src/catalog/data.go only (safety net) - unstage other files first."}}'
